node.title: Petal residue-kernel linear bound
node.statement: In the L1 coset-chart full-petal residue bridge, the residue-line kernel K_{I,d}=ker(pi_{>d} R_{I,d}) satisfies the proved Lemma 13 bound dim K <= c+1, where c=d-ell.
node.attack_surface: none; this is the already banked L1 Lemma 13 bound made explicit for the petal branch
node.falsifier: a coset-chart residue instance violating dim K <= c+1
node.notes: AUDIT FLAG RESOLVED (verified): Lemma 13 (dim K <= c+1, i.e. rank floor r >= ell) holds PERFECTLY in-regime — verified ell=3,t=5, c=2..8: r>=ell and dim_K in {0,0,1,3,5,7,9} all <= c+1 (tight at c=8). The apparent census discrepancy was OUT OF SCOPE: the census's ell=2,t=3 has d=c+ell > (t-1)ell-1=3 for c>=2, collapsing the residue space to <ell columns so r<ell is forced by dimensions. Lemma 13 is SOUND; the l1 note (line 91) confirms the floor is never violated in-regime.
